title: Blank flag fabric
note: Broad billowing folds and clean contrast. Map the exact flag vector later.

title: Palace at blue hour
note: Both variants alter architectural details. Neither passes the exact-reference gate. Use the real palace source; it crops the outer wings, so a wider source is still needed if the whole building must appear.

title: Classified dossier
note: Better margins around folder, paper and ribbon. Blank emblem and label areas.

title: Two security officers
note: v3 improves straight arms and side clearance. Framing is wider than head-to-knees. Badges, insignia and camouflage remain approximate; verify before use.

title: Three Su-30MKM jets
note: v2 has three separated planes in a triangular V. v1 is an echelon rather than the requested V. Verify airframe and small markings against the reference.

title: Cybersecurity researcher
note: v4 corrects tablet orientation and restores shoulder/elbow clearance. Earlier variants have awkward screen direction or cropped framing.

title: Student using phone
note: v1 has the requested leftward orientation but little margin by the right shoulder. v2 has more space but turns the other way.

title: Clear sky
note: v2 has more clear blue space and fewer clouds.

title: Haze sky
note: Even haze plate without land or a distinct sun.

title: Palace in daylight
note: Window, column and other architectural details drift from the reference. Use the real palace photograph and relight in Photoshop.

title: Army soldier
note: v2 adds the beret badge and keeps hands within frame. Uniform details and insignia require verification; reference photos do not establish current uniform standards.

title: Environmental researcher
note: Better framing and a clear abstract graph. Inspect tiny screen/button marks at final placement size and remove anything that reads as lettering.

title: Youths planting a tree
note: v4 shows all six hands separately with whole-figure framing. Soil contact still obscures some finger detail, so the strict 30-finger check is not certified. v1/v2 overlap hands; v3 hides one hand.

title: Rainforest foliage
note: Continuous bottom border with an irregular upper edge against dark forest.

title: C-130H Hercules
note: v1 shows four engines/propellers more clearly; v2 obscures an engine. Verify livery, geometry and markings before final use.

title: Sunrise sky
note: v1 has the cleaner sun shape. Both need restrained grading to match the composite.

title: KL skyline
note: Landmark ordering is broadly retained, but facade and smaller-building details change. Use the real skyline source; its night lighting still needs the planned sunrise treatment.

title: Palace at sunrise
note: Both alter architecture. Use the real palace photograph with non-generative relighting.

title: Solar farm
note: More restrained warmth and clearer rows than v1.

title: Police officer at port
note: Less invented adornment than v1 and good framing. Badge/cap details remain approximate and need verification.

title: Renewable-energy engineer
note: Both arms are within frame and the single solar cell reads clearly; v1 crops an arm.

title: Young professionals
note: Full figures, natural stride and more forward-looking gaze than v1.

title: Port at sunrise (optional)
note: Optional asset included. Inspect and retouch small hull markings that may read as invented text.
